assertion_results.evidence: Four cases (from-commits, release-cut, fix-order, no-version-stop), each with assertions. Reason given: "I wrote them because they're the only way to show the skill beats having no skill"

assertion_results.evidence: SKILL.md is about 2.3k chars and opens straight with "Write entries for people who use the project...". It has "## Scope" and "## Red flags" sections and no explanation of what a changelog is.
